preconditions.description: The input is a single integer n where 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(out_item.isdigit() for out_item in stdout.strip().split()) and len(stdout.strip().split()) == n
postconditions.description: The output is a sequence of exactly n integers, each representing a GCD value from the transformation process.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(out_item) <= n for out_item in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer is between 1 and n (inclusive), as it is a GCD of a subset of the sequence 1, 2, ..., n.

postconditions.expression: let sequence = list(range(1, int(stdin.strip()) + 1)); let result = []; let current_sequence = sequence.copy(); let output = stdout.strip().split(); let i = 0; all((i < len(output)) and (math.gcd(*current_sequence) == int(output[i])) and (len(current_sequence) == len(sequence) - i) for i in range(len(output)))
postconditions.description: The output sequence is the lexicographically maximum sequence of GCDs obtained by iteratively removing one element at a time from the initial sequence [1, 2, ..., n], where each GCD is computed from the remaining elements before removal. The process must start with the full sequence and end with a single element.
